validation_log.result: Room-service hardening: audit found the 1024-address rate-limit cap leaves an empty registry entry for a rejected address, crashing the next prune with an unhandled IndexError (reproduced against the old limiter). Fixed rate_limit to prune empty/stale entries, check the cap before recording a new address, and never retain an empty entry. Regression test test_rate_limit_global_cap_does_not_poison_registry added; it fails on old code and passes on new. Full suite: 13/13 tests pass including real Godot/ENet process fixtures. Steam lobby/invite evaluated and recorded (invite reuses existing room-ID+token admission; lobby browser needs App ID/SDK and must keep HTTPS version/capacity gating; Steam relay conflicts with authoritative ENet/UDP, so it is held). Milestone5.4: demand signals and add/relocate thresholds defined; no public deployment means measured demand is zero, so no capacity/placement change is justified; room-ID client UX confirmed machine-count-independent. No runtime gameplay change, no deployment, no infra apply. Evidence .scratch/phase5-room-service-tests.log.

validation_log.command: Constrained two-CPU 20-player runs with connection-through-admission ENet throttle/loss sampling (SCALE_ADMISSION/SCALE_TRANSPORT); five consecutive 20-player runs after throttle_configure(1000,2,1); full constrained 4/8/20 matrix; supported PLAYER_COUNTS='1 2 4' tests/run_ui_regression.sh
validation_log.result: Root cause proven in Godot 4.7.2 ENet source: per-ACK throttle compares instantaneous RTT against a lastRoundTripTime/lastRoundTripTimeVariance baseline re-seeded only once per 5000ms, so a fast-joining peer latches a quiet-time baseline (~12ms) and the admission burst ratchets unreliable sends to zero with PEER_PACKET_LOSS=0. Fix is throttle_configure(1000,2,1) per accepted peer: faster baseline re-seed and gentler deceleration, congestion backoff retained. Five consecutive constrained 20-player runs pass (movement=passed on all clients); full constrained 4/8/20 matrix passes; UI_REGRESSION_OK suites=41 matrices=5 persistence_restart=passed, PLAYABLE_SCALE_MATRIX_OK players=1,2,4, DEDICATED_NETWORK_OK movement=passed rematches=5 recovery=passed. Batching admission spawns and roster-scaled movement cadence were attempted and reverted: neither reduced admission throttle collapse, so throttle tuning is the shipped fix and traffic shape is unchanged. Supported playtest capacity stays four; no deployment. Evidence .scratch/phase5-{admission-baseline,admission-baseline2,throttle-1..5,throttle-matrix,throttle-regression}.log.

validation_log.result: Broader acceptance remains only partially substantiated despite the green regression gate. Flood route tests walk to high ground BEFORE starting the warning, so they prove walkability and peak refuge safety, not escape while water rises. Collapse tests/selection preserve one paired piece but do not execute relocation to it under active Flood+Earthquake. The map tornado-reach test accepts distance <=15m while the runtime influence radius defaults to 8m; this assertion is not proof of actual exposure (no safe-camping exploit reproduced). Timed escape, post-collapse relocation and actual refuge exposure need focused executed scenarios before claiming full fairness verification. Archived evidence also lacks Phase 4-specific 2/4-player profiles for both maps; native Windows/GPU 60FPS, physical audio/Internet feel and human Normal/Hard cause recognition/escape/rematch comparisons remain unverified. Preserve the existing human waiver and historical archive; do not retroactively claim these gates passed or start Phase 5 implementation.

archive.reason: Gates-complete checkpoint, not a closure.
